overloadMerges.note: The two doc syntax lines are the same call with a leading '*' literal-symbol discriminator selecting whether object is an object name (Text) or a direct Variable/Field reference, not two distinct overloads. filtersArr/allowDenyArr are filled by the command (marked with the '←' return arrow in the parameter table), so their direction is 'out', not the syntax-position default of 'in'.

params.description: If passed, object is an object name (string); if omitted, object is a variable or field reference.

params.name: object
params.description: Object name (if * is passed) or Variable/Field reference (if * is omitted).

discriminatedBy.rule: Text (an object name) when the leading * is passed; Variable or Field passed directly when * is omitted.
